conventions: Every file is a JSON array of row objects; missing values are null.
Files with a 'contig' column hold one row per contig (chr1..chr22, chrX, chrY) plus the roll-ups 'autosomes' (chr1-22) and 'all'. Show 'autosomes' by default.
Variant statistics describe the full joint call set (biallelic SNVs and short indels with at least one alternate allele), not the Beacon release (AC >= 5 and AF >= 0.1%).
Per-sample figures are published as histograms and summaries only; there are no per-sample rows.
Histogram windows run from the 0.1th to the 99.9th percentile; samples outside the window are counted in n_below and n_above of the matching summary file.
chrX and chrY are not ploidy-aware: allele numbers there are inflated and their low-frequency calls have a very low Ts/Tv. Keep them out of headline numbers or label them as preliminary.

files.title: Variants per contig
files.description: Number of SNVs, indels and MNPs per contig, singleton share, Ts/Tv of SNVs, contig length and variants per Mb.
files.source: Beacon sites-only VCFs (AC, AN from dense call_stats)
files.chart: table, bar chart of records_per_mb by contig

columns.indel: insertions and deletions (REF and ALT of different length)
columns.mnp: same-length multi-base variants (0 in this call set)
columns.singleton_pct: percent of records that are singletons
columns.length_bp: contig length from the VCF header

notes: Multiallelic sites are split into biallelic records, so there is no multiallelic count.

files.title: Ts/Tv by allele-frequency class
files.description: Transition/transversion ratio of SNVs overall and within each frequency class.
files.chart: bar chart of titv by class, one series per contig group

columns.class: all, singleton, doubleton, rare, low_frequency, common, very_common, monomorphic_alt

notes: Classes follow maf_classes: singleton MAC 1; doubleton MAC 2; rare MAC >= 3 and MAF < 0.1%; low_frequency 0.1-1%; common 1-5%; very_common >= 5%.
Ts/Tv falls steeply toward rare variants, the usual sign of false positives among rare calls; present by class and not as one headline value.

files.title: SNV substitution spectrum (6 classes)
files.description: Share of SNVs in the six strand-collapsed substitution classes, for all variants and for singletons only.
files.chart: grouped bar chart, scope all vs singleton

columns.substitution: C>A, C>G, C>T, T>A, T>C, T>G (pyrimidine reference)

notes: SNVs with non-ACGT alleles are excluded.

files.title: SNV substitution spectrum (12 classes)
files.description: The same spectrum before strand collapsing: all twelve REF>ALT substitutions.

files.title: Indel length distribution
files.description: Number of indels by signed length (insertions positive, deletions negative).
files.chart: bar chart over length, log y-axis optional

columns.length: len(ALT) - len(REF), clipped to -51..51; 51 means more than 50 bp inserted, -51 more than 50 bp deleted

notes: The largest file; request only 'autosomes' or 'all' for the default view.

files.title: Variants by frequency class
files.description: Number and share of variant sites in each minor-allele-frequency class, for SNVs, indels and all.

columns.class: monomorphic_alt, singleton, doubleton, rare, low_frequency, common, very_common

notes: MAF is folded: min(AF, 1 - AF) with AF = AC / AN.
The contigs included are listed in maf_summary.tsv on the cluster.

files.title: Minor allele frequency spectrum
files.description: Variant sites per MAF bin on a log scale, four bins per decade.
files.chart: stacked histogram on a log x-axis, SNV and indel

columns.maf_upper: upper bin edge (the last bin is capped at 0.5 when drawn)

files.title: Common-variant frequency spectrum
files.description: Variant sites per MAF bin for MAF of 1% and above, in 1% bins.

files.title: Variant missingness
files.description: Variant sites by missingness, 1 - AN / (2N), in 1% bins.
files.chart: histogram with log y-axis; cumulative call-rate curve can be derived
notes: Autosomes only: haploid calls on chrX and chrY lower AN for reasons other than missing data.

files.title: Variant call-rate summary
files.description: Share of sites that are fully called and that reach call rates of 99, 95, 90 and 50 percent.

columns.type: snp, indel, all, plus bookkeeping rows (bad_records_skipped, an_gt_2n_clamped)
columns.pct_callrate_ge_99: percent of sites with call rate >= 99%
columns.pct_callrate_ge_95: percent of sites with call rate >= 95%
columns.pct_callrate_ge_90: percent of sites with call rate >= 90%
columns.pct_callrate_ge_50: percent of sites with call rate >= 50%

notes: Skip the bookkeeping rows when drawing.

files.title: Missingness by contig
files.description: Fully called share and mean missingness per autosome.

files.title: Variant QUAL and Ts/Tv by QUAL (raw calls)
files.description: QUAL distribution of the per-sample raw calls summed over all samples, with transitions and transversions per QUAL value.
files.source: per-sample bcftools stats, before joint calling
files.chart: cumulative curve over QUAL (log x); Ts/Tv by QUAL bin
notes: Raw per-sample HaplotypeCaller calls, not the joint call set. Label as 'raw calls'.

files.title: Per-sample variants, joint call set (histograms)
files.description: Distribution across samples of variants per sample, Ts/Tv, het/hom ratio and singletons per sample.
files.source: joint call set (VDS), biallelic variants with at least one alternate allele
notes: Singleton counts are strongly skewed; consider a log x-axis.

files.title: Per-sample variants, joint call set (summary)
files.description: Mean, standard deviation, quartiles and the 1st and 99th percentiles of each per-sample metric.
files.chart: table; n_below and n_above give the samples outside the histogram window

files.title: Per-sample variants, raw calls (histograms)
files.description: Distribution across samples of raw-call variant counts, Ts/Tv and the share of low-QUAL SNV and indel calls.
files.source: per-sample bcftools stats, before joint calling

metrics.pct_snp_qual_lt30: percent of SNV calls with QUAL below 30
metrics.pct_indel_qual_lt30: percent of indel calls with QUAL below 30

notes: Raw per-sample calls, not the joint call set; counts differ from vds_hist. Label as 'raw calls'.

files.title: Per-sample variants, raw calls (summary)
files.description: Summary statistics of the raw-call metrics.

files.title: Alignment quality per sample (histograms)
files.description: Distribution across samples of sequencing yield, mapping, duplication, pairing, error rate, base quality, read length and insert size.
files.source: samtools stats of the per-sample alignments

metrics.pct_mapq0: percent of reads with mapping quality 0
metrics.pct_pairs_diff_chr: percent of pairs mapping to different chromosomes

notes: Available for 22,960 of the 23,058 samples; n and n_missing in alignment_summary give the exact numbers.

files.title: Alignment quality per sample (summary)
files.description: Summary statistics of the alignment metrics.
